recipes.name: Penecillin Soup
instructions: Melt the butter, cook the carrot, onion, celery on medium heat until soft (not browned).
Stir in the garlic and pepper, cook until fragrant.
Stir in the pasta, mix until coated in butter.
Add stock, simmer until al dente.
Add the Nooch and lemon, then pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Noodle Bake
instructions: In large bowl, combine: garlic, ginger, onion whites, miso paste, maple syrup, vinegar, peanut butter, tahini and soy sauce. Whisk until smooth.
Pour in coconut milk and stock, whisk until combined.
Add noodles to baking dish, pour over sauce. Top with dumplings.
Scatter sesame seeds and onion greens before serving.
